environment.network: local loopback, unthrottled for navigation measurements
environment.renderMetric: CourseItem commits recorded by a build-flag-gated effect; includes initial mount
environment.note: Baseline immediately shows the report; optimized initially shows the open button. Load event and report-ready times are distinct.
environment.lighthouseCachePolicy: Fresh browser per audit; login bootstrap seeds localStorage; Lighthouse disableStorageReset=true retains the authenticated session. This is distinct from the cache-disabled CDP navigation runs.
environment.prefetch: Normal Next.js navigation prefetch was retained. Network totals include background script fetches in the initial observation window (700 ms idle after UI readiness). First baseline run had no navigation-prefetched scripts; later baseline runs included 26,242 bytes of those scripts.
